lines.text: The speaker tells the listener to keep his commandments and live, and to write them on the heart.
Looking through the lattice, the speaker sees a young man lacking judgment strolling toward a woman's house at sunrise.
A cunning woman dressed as a harlot comes out, seizes the young man, and kisses him.
She says her bed has linen from Babylon and her husband will not return till the moon is full.
The speaker tells his listeners not to stray into her paths, because her house is the road to Sheol.
